graphicDesign.title: Three Wise Monkeys — DAMN.
graphicDesign.description:
A conceptual poster inspired by the traditional philosophy of the Three Wise Monkeys — See No Evil, Speak No Evil, Hear No Evil.

This artwork reinterprets the philosophy through a contemporary visual approach, combining self-portrait photography, bold typography, textured backgrounds, and red graphic elements.

The composition explores the idea of selective awareness and the human tendency to ignore uncomfortable realities.

graphicDesign.title: Chasing Greatness / Angst Grunge
graphicDesign.description:
An intense visual study on raw ambition, artistic struggle, and creative perseverance.

Crafted with high-contrast halftone dot matrix texturing, heavy crimson red duotones, distressed typography ("pain pain ... chasing greatness"), and underground punk zine sensibilities.

Expresses the internal friction between pressure and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

graphicDesign.title: DSPM University — BJMC Department
graphicDesign.description:
“Step into a world where your voice matters and your creativity shapes reality.”

An architectural typography poster designed for the Department of Journalism & Mass Communication at Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee University, Ranchi.

Blends monumental three-dimensional typography with campus architecture and street-sign iconography to welcome passionate storytellers into media professionals.

graphicDesign.title: NITIN — Fallible God
graphicDesign.description:
“Chat I think I'm in love — to fall in love is to create a religion that has a fallible god.”

A stark, dual-tone editorial poster marrying bold color blocking (crimson red over magenta pink) with high-contrast graphic self-portraiture.

Investigates the psychology of infatuation, romantic idealization, and the vulnerability of placing unconditional faith in imperfect human beings.

graphicDesign.title: We Were Love
graphicDesign.description:
“We were not lovers, we were love.”

A tender, textured graphic exploration of connection that transcends conventional definitions.

Incorporates delicate cyan-magenta CMYK halftone rosettes, glowing dreamlike typography, an intricate anatomical heart, and a black butterfly representing transformation and delicate emotional states.

graphicDesign.title: The Myth of Saintliness / Teresa Critique
graphicDesign.description:
A provocative, critical journalism poster examining media narratives, historical sanctification, and investigative accountability.

Rendered in deep saturated cobalt blue with electrostatic noise textures and bold yellow text highlights.

Challenges uncritical consensus through the lens of evidence-based media ethics and contrarian historical inquiry.

graphicDesign.title: Sunshine / Blue Means You
graphicDesign.description:
“As I sit down to write this letter, I'm filled with a mix of emotions... And to me, blue means you.”

A visual love letter evoking the sensation of vintage silkscreen printing and sun-faded risograph prints.

Combines intimate serif prose, dot-matrix halftone grain, and striking magenta hues to capture the bittersweet warmth of nostalgic memories.

graphicDesign.title: BLINDED
graphicDesign.description:
“It's so embarrassing, all the love I seek is living inside of me and I can't see, I'm blind.”

A maximalist acid-grunge visual statement combining surreal cloudscape collage, distorted heavy display typography, barbed surveillance-eye graphics, and deeply personal self-reflection.

Explores self-doubt, inner perception, and emotional awakening.
